enemy_turn.text: [TUTORIAL] The enemy will now attack by casting INSULTS at you.

This is your RESOLVE gague. Filling it up will earn you a new life.
Gain RESOLVE by successfully defending against INSULTS!
Timing your hits to the music, which boosts your RESOLVE gain!
